trouper|UW T ER.why: Rhyme Key is UW1 P ER0, but 'computer' needs UW1 T ER0, so the consonant differs.

wooer|UW T ER.why: Rhyme Key is UW1 ER0 with no T, so it lacks the T of 'computer' (UW1 T ER0).

beauts|UW T S.why: Rhyme Key UW1 T S matches 'grassroots' (UW2 T S); the onset is ignored.

brutes|UW T S.why: Rhyme Key UW1 T S is identical to that of 'roots'.

foots|UW T S.why: 'Foots' has the vowel UH (UH1 T S), not UW, so the vowel differs from 'roots'.

soups|UW T S.why: Ends in UW1 P S, with P instead of T, so the consonant after the vowel differs.
